item.name: 🔗 Get E-Statement Account Preferences

request.description:
Retrieve the user's accounts and identify an account ID for subsequent requests.

Saves `account_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/accounts?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

Retrieve e-statement disclosure preferences for the specified account.

```
GET /v1/e-statements/{{account_id}}/disclosures?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

Retrieve the user's accounts and identify an account ID for subsequent requests.

Saves `account_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/accounts
```

Retrieve e-statement disclosure preferences for the specified account.

```
GET /v1/e-statements/{{account_id}}/disclosures
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get E-Statement Account Preferences Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search For Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the account ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Get E-Statement Account Preferences | Retrieve the E-Statement preferences settings for the identified account. |

item.name: Single Customer

exec: throw new Error("Environment variable 'retail_user_login_id' is not set. This request looks up the customer by LOGIN_ID.");

request.description:
Retrieve the customer record and identify `retail_customer_id` for subsequent requests.

Saves `retail_customer_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/customers/{{retail_user_login_id}}?userIdType=LOGIN_ID
```

Retrieve the e-statement accounts opt-in report for a single customer.

```
POST /v1/reports/e-statements
```

item.name: 3b. [Option 2] Get E-Statement Accounts Opt-In Report - Account Type Filter

request.description:
Retrieve the e-statement accounts opt-in report for a single customer, filtered by account type.

```
POST /v1/reports/e-statements
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get E-Statement Accounts Opt-In Report - Single Customer Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Retail Customer ID | (Optional) Retrieve the Retail Customer ID if it is not already known. The ID is available in the customers array as customerId. |
| 3a | \[Option 1\] Get E-Statement Accounts Opt-In Report | Retrieve E‑Statement opt‑in and statement delivery preferences for all accounts associated with the specified customer. |
| 3b | \[Option 2\] Get E-Statement Accounts Opt-In Report - Account Type Filter | Retrieve E‑Statement opt‑in and statement delivery preferences for the specified customer, filtered by account type. |
